"""Tests for pylint/checkers/misc.py"""

import tokenize
import io
from unittest import mock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch, PropertyMock

import pytest

from pylint.checkers import misc
from pylint.testutils import CheckerTestCase, MessageTest, UnittestLinter
from pylint.testutils import set_config


class TestEncodingChecker(CheckerTestCase):
    CHECKER_CLASS = misc.EncodingChecker

    def test_fixme_found(self):
        """Test that FIXME comments are detected."""
        with self.assertAddsMessages(
            MessageTest(
                msg_id="fixme",
                line=1,
                args="FIXME: something to fix",
                col_offset=1,
            )
        ):
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# FIXME: something to fix",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 25),
                        line="# FIXME: something to fix\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_xxx_found(self):
        """Test that XXX comments are detected."""
        with self.assertAddsMessages(
            MessageTest(
                msg_id="fixme",
                line=1,
                args="XXX: something",
                col_offset=1,
            )
        ):
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# XXX: something",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 17),
                        line="# XXX: something\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_todo_found(self):
        """Test that TODO comments are detected."""
        with self.assertAddsMessages(
            MessageTest(
                msg_id="fixme",
                line=1,
                args="TODO: something to do",
                col_offset=1,
            )
        ):
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# TODO: something to do",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 23),
                        line="# TODO: something to do\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_no_fixme_in_regular_comment(self):
        """Test that regular comments don't trigger fixme."""
        with self.assertNoMessages():
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# This is a regular comment",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 27),
                        line="# This is a regular comment\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_fixme_case_insensitive(self):
        """Test that fixme detection is case insensitive."""
        with self.assertAddsMessages(
            MessageTest(
                msg_id="fixme",
                line=1,
                args="fixme: lowercase",
                col_offset=1,
            )
        ):
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# fixme: lowercase",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 18),
                        line="# fixme: lowercase\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_no_fixme_when_notes_empty(self):
        """Test that no messages are added when notes config is empty."""
        self.checker.config.notes = []
        with self.assertNoMessages():
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# FIXME: something",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 18),
                        line="# FIXME: something\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_fixme_disabled_by_pylint_comment(self):
        """Test that fixme is not reported when disabled via pylint comment."""
        with self.assertNoMessages():
            self.checker.process_tokens(
                [
                    tokenize.TokenInfo(
                        type=tokenize.COMMENT,
                        string="# pylint: disable=fixme",
                        start=(1, 0),
                        end=(1, 23),
                        line="# pylint: disable=fixme\n",
                    )
                ]
            )

    def test_process_module_with_ascii_encoding(self):
        """Test process_module with ASCII encoding."""
        node = MagicMock()
        node.file_encoding = "ascii"
        node.name = "test_module"
        
        stream_content = b"# This is ascii content\n"
        node.stream.return_value.__enter__ = MagicMock(
            return_value=iter([stream_content])
        )
        node.stream.return_value.__exit__ = MagicMock(return_value=False)
        
        with self.assertNoMessages():
            self.checker.process_module(node)

    def test_process_module_no_encoding(self):
        """Test process_module when file_encoding is None (defaults to ascii)."""
        node = MagicMock()
        node.file_encoding = None
        node.name = "test_module"
        
        stream_content = b"# ascii content\n"
        node.stream.return_value.__enter__ = MagicMock(
            return_value=iter([stream_content])
        )
        node.stream.return_value.__exit__ = MagicMock(return_value=False)
        
        with self.assertNoMessages():
            self.checker.process_module(node)

    def test_check_encoding_valid(self):
        """Test _check_encoding with valid encoding."""
        result = self.checker._check_encoding(1, b"hello world", "utf-8")
        assert result == "hello world"

    def test_check_encoding_unicode_error(self):
        """Test _check_encoding with invalid bytes for encoding."""
        result = self.checker._check_encoding(1, b"\xff\xfe", "ascii")
        assert result is None

    def test_check_encoding_lookup_error_with_coding_line(self):
        """Test _check_encoding with LookupError for bad encoding in coding line."""
        with self.assertAddsMessages(
            MessageTest(
                msg_id="syntax-error",
                line=1,
                args="Cannot decode using encoding 'bad-encoding', bad encoding",
            )
        ):

import datetime

import numpy as np

from xarray import DataArray, Dataset
from xarray.core.groupby import (
    _consolidate_slices,
    _dummy_copy,
    _inverse_permutation_indices,
    _is_one_or_none,
    _maybe_reorder,
    _unique_and_monotonic,
    check_reduce_dims,
    unique_value_groups,
    _DummyGroup,
    GroupBy,
    DataArrayGroupBy,
    DatasetGroupBy,
)


# ===== Tests for check_reduce_dims =====

def test_check_reduce_dims_ellipsis():
    # Should not raise
    check_reduce_dims(..., ("x", "y"))


def test_check_reduce_dims_valid_scalar():
    # Should not raise
    check_reduce_dims("x", ("x", "y"))


def test_check_reduce_dims_valid_list():
    check_reduce_dims(["x", "y"], ("x", "y"))


def test_check_reduce_dims_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cannot reduce over dimensions"):
        check_reduce_dims("z", ("x", "y"))


def test_check_reduce_dims_invalid_list():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cannot reduce over dimensions"):
        check_reduce_dims(["x", "z"], ("x", "y"))


# ===== Tests for unique_value_groups =====

def test_unique_value_groups_basic():
    ar = np.array([1, 2, 1, 3, 2])
    values, groups = unique_value_groups(ar)
    assert list(values) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert groups[0] == [0, 2]
    assert groups[1] == [1, 4]
    assert groups[2] == [3]


def test_unique_value_groups_no_sort():
    ar = np.array([3, 1, 2, 1])
    values, groups = unique_value_groups(ar, sort=False)
    # With sort=False, order depends on first occurrence
    assert len(values) == 3


def test_unique_value_groups_with_nan():
    ar = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 1.0, 2.0])
    values, groups = unique_value_groups(ar)
    # NaN should be excluded from values
    assert np.nan not in values


# ===== Tests for _dummy_copy =====

    ds = Dataset({"a": ("x", [1, 2, 3])}, coords={"x": [0, 1, 2]})
    result = _dummy_copy(ds)
    assert isinstance(result, Dataset)


def test_dummy_copy_dataarray():
    da = DataArray([1, 2, 3], dims=["x"], attrs={"units": "m"})
    result = _dummy_copy(da)
    assert isinstance(result, DataArray)
    assert result.attrs == da.attrs


def test_dummy_copy_dataarray_with_coords():
    da = DataArray(
        [[1, 2], [3, 4]],
        dims=["x", "y"],
        coords={"lat": ("x", [10.0, 20.0])},
    )
    result = _dummy_copy(da)
    assert isinstance(result, DataArray)

def test_consolidate_slices_basic():

from __future__ import annotations

import flask
from flask import Flask
from flask.cli import (
    AppGroup,

    NoAppException,

    SeparatedPathType,
    _called_with_wrong_args,
    _path_is_ancestor,

)

# ─── find_best_app ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_find_best_app_by_name_app():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)
    module.app = app
    assert find_best_app(module) is app


def test_find_best_app_by_name_application():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)
    module.application = app
    assert find_best_app(module) is app


def test_find_best_app_single_instance():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)
    module.my_app = app
    assert find_best_app(module) is app


def test_find_best_app_multiple_instances_raises():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    module.app1 = Flask(__name__)
    module.app2 = Flask(__name__)
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="multiple"):
        find_best_app(module)


def test_find_best_app_factory_create_app():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)

    def create_app():
        return app

    module.create_app = create_app
    assert find_best_app(module) is app


def test_find_best_app_factory_make_app():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)

    def make_app():
        return app

    module.make_app = make_app
    assert find_best_app(module) is app


def test_find_best_app_no_app_raises():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException):
        find_best_app(module)


def test_find_best_app_factory_wrong_args():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"

    def create_app(required_arg):
        return Flask(__name__)

    module.create_app = create_app
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="could not call"):
        find_best_app(module)

def test_find_app_by_string_variable():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)
    module.myapp = app
    assert find_app_by_string(module, "myapp") is app


def test_find_app_by_string_function_call():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)

    def create_app():
        return app

    module.create_app = create_app
    assert find_app_by_string(module, "create_app()") is app


def test_find_app_by_string_function_call_with_args():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)

    def create_app(name="test"):
        return app

    module.create_app = create_app
    assert find_app_by_string(module, "create_app('test')") is app


def test_find_app_by_string_syntax_error():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="Failed to parse"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "!!!invalid!!!")


def test_find_app_by_string_not_flask_instance():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    module.notapp = "just a string"
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="valid Flask application"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "notapp")


def test_find_app_by_string_attribute_not_found():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="Failed to find attribute"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "nonexistent")


def test_find_app_by_string_complex_func_name():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="simple name"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "a.b()")


def test_find_app_by_string_invalid_literal_args():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    app = Flask(__name__)

    def create_app(x):
        return app

    module.create_app = create_app
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="literal values"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "create_app(some_var)")


def test_find_app_by_string_factory_wrong_args():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"

    def create_app(required):
        return Flask(__name__)

    module.create_app = create_app
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="could not be called"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "create_app()")


def test_find_app_by_string_not_name_or_call():
    module = types.ModuleType("mymodule")
    module.__name__ = "mymodule"
    # An expression that is neither Name nor Call (e.g., a number literal)
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException, match="Failed to parse"):
        find_app_by_string(module, "42")

def test_script_info_load_app_with_create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    info = ScriptInfo(create_app=lambda: app)
    loaded = info.load_app()
    assert loaded is app


def test_script_info_load_app_cached():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    call_count = [0]

    def factory():
        call_count[0] += 1
        return app

    info = ScriptInfo(create_app=factory)
    info.load_app()
    info.load_app()
    assert call_count[0] == 1


def test_script_info_no_app_raises():
    info = ScriptInfo()
    # No app_import_path, no create_app, no wsgi.py/app.py in cwd
    with pytest.raises(NoAppException):
        info.load_app()


def test_script_info_load_app_with_import_path():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    module = types.ModuleType("testmod_scriptinfo")
    module.__name__ = "testmod_scriptinfo"
    module.app = app
    sys.modules["testmod_scriptinfo"] = module
    try:
        info = ScriptInfo(app_import_path="testmod_scriptinfo", set_debug_flag=False)
        loaded = info.load_app()
        assert loaded is app
    finally:
        del sys.modules["testmod_scriptinfo"]

def test_get_version(runner):
    @click.command()
    @click.option("--version", is_flag=True, callback=get_version, expose_value=False, is_eager=True)
    def cmd():
        pass

    result = runner.invoke(cmd, ["--version"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert "Flask" in result.output
    assert "Python" in result.output
    assert "Werkzeug" in result.output

# Licensed under a 3-clause BSD style license - see LICENSE.rst

import io
import os
import copy
import warnings
import pytest
import numpy as np

from astropy.io import fits
from astropy.wcs import WCS, find_all_wcs, validate
from astropy.wcs.wcs import (
    NoConvergence, FITSFixedWarning, _parse_keysel, WCSHDO_SIP
)
from astropy.utils.exceptions import AstropyWarning, AstropyUserWarning, AstropyDeprecationWarning


# ============================================================
# Helper functions to create simple WCS headers
# ============================================================

def make_simple_wcs_header(naxis=2, crpix=(50, 50), crval=(180, 0),
                            cdelt=(-0.001, 0.001), ctype=('RA---TAN', 'DEC--TAN')):
    """Create a simple FITS header with WCS keywords."""
    header = fits.Header()
    header['NAXIS'] = naxis
    header['NAXIS1'] = 100
    header['NAXIS2'] = 100
    for i in range(1, naxis + 1):
        header['NAXIS{}'.format(i)] = 100
    header['CRPIX1'] = crpix[0]
    header['CRPIX2'] = crpix[1]
    header['CRVAL1'] = crval[0]
    header['CRVAL2'] = crval[1]
    header['CDELT1'] = cdelt[0]
    header['CDELT2'] = cdelt[1]
    header['CTYPE1'] = ctype[0]
    header['CTYPE2'] = ctype[1]
    return header


def make_simple_wcs(naxis=2):
    """Create a simple WCS object."""
    header = make_simple_wcs_header(naxis=naxis)
    return WCS(header)


# ============================================================
# Tests for NoConvergence
# ============================================================

def test_no_convergence_basic():
    exc = NoConvergence("test message")
    assert str(exc) == "test message"
    assert exc.best_solution is None
    assert exc.accuracy is None
    assert exc.niter is None
    assert exc.divergent is None
    assert exc.slow_conv is None


def test_no_convergence_with_kwargs():
    best = np.array([[1.0, 2.0]])
    acc = np.array([[0.001, 0.001]])
    exc = NoConvergence("test", best_solution=best, accuracy=acc,
                        niter=5, divergent=np.array([0]), slow_conv=None)
    assert exc.niter == 5
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(exc.best_solution, best)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(exc.accuracy, acc)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(exc.divergent, np.array([0]))
    assert exc.slow_conv is None


def test_no_convergence_unexpected_kwargs():
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        exc = NoConvergence("test", unexpected_kwarg=42)
    assert len(w) == 1
    assert issubclass(w[0].category, AstropyDeprecationWarning)


# ============================================================
# Tests for FITSFixedWarning
# ============================================================

def test_fits_fixed_warning():
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        warnings.warn("test", FITSFixedWarning)
    assert len(w) == 1
    assert issubclass(w[0].category, FITSFixedWarning)


# ============================================================
# Tests for _parse_keysel
# ============================================================

def test_parse_keysel_none():
    result = _parse_keysel(None)
    assert result == -1


def test_parse_keysel_image():
    from astropy.wcs import _wcs as _wcs_mod
    result = _parse_keysel(['image'])
    assert result == _wcs_mod.WCSHDR_IMGHEAD


def test_parse_keysel_binary():
    from astropy.wcs import _wcs as _wcs_mod
    result = _parse_keysel(['binary'])
    assert result == _wcs_mod.WCSHDR_BIMGARR


def test_parse_keysel_pixel():
    from astropy.wcs import _wcs as _wcs_mod
    result = _parse_keysel(['pixel'])
    assert result == _wcs_mod.WCSHDR_PIXLIST


def test_parse_keysel_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="keysel must be a list"):
        _parse_keysel(['invalid'])


def test_parse_keysel_multiple():
    from astropy.wcs import _wcs as _wcs_mod
    result = _parse_keysel(['image', 'binary'])
    assert result == (_wcs_mod.WCSHDR_IMGHEAD | _wcs_mod.WCSHDR_BIMGARR)


# ============================================================
# Tests for WCS initialization
# ============================================================

def test_wcs_default_init():
    w = WCS()
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_from_header():
    header = make_simple_wcs_header()
    w = WCS(header)
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_from_header_string():
    header = make_simple_wcs_header()
    header_string = header.tostring()
    w = WCS(header_string)
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_from_dict_like():
    d = {
        'NAXIS': 2,
        'NAXIS1': 100,
        'NAXIS2': 100,
        'CRPIX1': 50.0,
        'CRPIX2': 50.0,
        'CRVAL1': 180.0,
        'CRVAL2': 0.0,
        'CDELT1': -0.001,
        'CDELT2': 0.001,
        'CTYPE1': 'RA---TAN',
        'CTYPE2': 'DEC--TAN',
    }
    w = WCS(d)
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_invalid_header_type():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        WCS(12345)


def test_wcs_naxis_kwarg():
    w = WCS(naxis=3)
    assert w.naxis == 3


def test_wcs_key():
    header = make_simple_wcs_header()
    w = WCS(header, key=' ')
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_from_image_hdu():
    header = make_simple_wcs_header()
    hdu = fits.ImageHDU(data=np.zeros((100, 100)), header=header)
    w = WCS(hdu)
    assert w.naxis == 2


def test_wcs_from_primary_hdu():
    header = make_simple_wcs_header()
    hdu = fits.PrimaryHDU(data=np.zeros((100, 100)), header=header)
    w = WCS(hdu)
    assert w.naxis == 2


# ============================================================
# Tests for WCS copy/deepcopy
# ============================================================

def test_wcs_copy():
    w = make_simple_wcs()
    w_copy = w.copy()
    assert w_copy.naxis == w.naxis
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(w_copy.wcs.crval, w.wcs.crval)


def test_wcs_deepcopy():
    w = make_simple_wcs()

"""
Unit tests for sympy/core/function.py
"""
import pytest
from sympy import (
    Symbol, symbols, Function, Lambda, Derivative, Subs,
    sin, cos, exp, log, sqrt, pi, oo, I, S, Integer, Rational, Float,
    Add, Mul, Pow, diff, expand, expand_mul, expand_multinomial,
    expand_log, expand_func, expand_trig, expand_complex,
    expand_power_base, expand_power_exp, count_ops, nfloat,
    WildFunction, atan2, loggamma, gamma
)
from sympy.abc import x, y, z, t, h
from sympy.core.function import (
    _coeff_isneg, PoleError, ArgumentIndexError, BadSignatureError,
    BadArgumentsError, arity, FunctionClass, Application, AppliedUndef,
    UndefinedFunction, nfloat, diff, expand
)
from sympy.core.symbol import Dummy
from sympy.core.containers import Tuple
from sympy.sets.sets import FiniteSet
from sympy.sets.fancysets import Naturals0


# ===== Tests for _coeff_isneg =====

def test_coeff_isneg_negative_mul():
    assert _coeff_isneg(-3*pi) == True

def test_coeff_isneg_positive():
    assert _coeff_isneg(S(3)) == False

def test_coeff_isneg_negative_oo():
    assert _coeff_isneg(-oo) == True

def test_coeff_isneg_symbol():
    n = Symbol('n', negative=True)
    assert _coeff_isneg(n) == False

def test_coeff_isneg_positive_mul():
    assert _coeff_isneg(3*pi) == False

def test_coeff_isneg_matmul():
    from sympy import MatrixSymbol
    A = MatrixSymbol("A", 3, 3)
    assert _coeff_isneg(-sqrt(2)*A) == True
    assert _coeff_isneg(sqrt(2)*A) == False


# ===== Tests for PoleError =====

def test_pole_error():
    with pytest.raises(PoleError):
        raise PoleError("test")


# ===== Tests for ArgumentIndexError =====

def test_argument_index_error():
    f = Function('f')
    err = ArgumentIndexError(f, 2)
    assert "2" in str(err)


# ===== Tests for BadSignatureError =====

def test_bad_signature_error():
    with pytest.raises(BadSignatureError):
        raise BadSignatureError("bad sig")


# ===== Tests for BadArgumentsError =====

def test_bad_arguments_error():
    with pytest.raises(BadArgumentsError):
        raise BadArgumentsError("bad args")


# ===== Tests for arity =====

def test_arity_lambda():
    assert arity(lambda x: x) == 1

def test_arity_log():
    assert arity(log) == (1, 2)

def test_arity_varargs():
    assert arity(lambda *x: sum(x)) is None

def test_arity_two_args():
    assert arity(lambda x, y: x + y) == 2

def test_arity_with_default():
    assert arity(lambda x, y=1: x + y) == (1, 2)


# ===== Tests for FunctionClass =====

def test_function_class_nargs():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f.nargs == S.Naturals0

def test_function_class_nargs_finite():
    f = Function('f', nargs=1)
    assert f.nargs == FiniteSet(1)

def test_function_class_nargs_tuple():
    f = Function('f', nargs=(2, 1))
    assert f.nargs == FiniteSet(1, 2)

def test_function_class_repr():
    f = Function('f')
    assert repr(f) == 'f'

def test_function_class_free_symbols():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f.free_symbols == set()


# ===== Tests for Function =====

def test_function_undefined():
    f = Function('f')
    assert isinstance(f, UndefinedFunction)

def test_function_applied():
    f = Function('f')
    expr = f(x)
    assert isinstance(expr, AppliedUndef)

def test_function_args():
    f = Function('f')
    expr = f(x)
    assert expr.args == (x,)

def test_function_func():
    f = Function('f')
    expr = f(x)
    assert expr.func == f

def test_function_nargs_applied():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).nargs == S.Naturals0

def test_function_wrong_nargs():
    class myf(Function):
        nargs = 1
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        myf(x, y)

def test_function_eval():
    class myf(Function):
        @classmethod
        def eval(cls, x):
            if x.is_zero:
                return S.One
    assert myf(0) == 1
    assert myf(x) == myf(x)

def test_function_diff():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).diff(x) == Derivative(f(x), x)

def test_function_is_commutative():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).is_commutative == True

def test_function_as_base_exp():
    f = Function('f')
    base, exp_ = f(x).as_base_exp()
    assert base == f(x)
    assert exp_ == S.One

def test_function_evalf():
    assert abs(float(sin(Float('1.0'))) - float(sin(1))) < 1e-10

def test_function_class_key():
    assert sin.class_key() == (4, 20, 'sin')
    assert cos.class_key() == (4, 21, 'cos')

def test_function_should_evalf():
    # Float argument should trigger evalf
    result = sin(Float('1.0'))
    assert isinstance(result, Float)


# ===== Tests for AppliedUndef =====

def test_applied_undef_diff_wrt():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x)._diff_wrt == True

def test_applied_undef_is_number():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).is_number == False

def test_applied_undef_invalid_arg():
    f = Function('f')
    g = Function('g')
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        f(g)


# ===== Tests for UndefinedFunction =====

def test_undefined_function_name():
    f = Function('f')
    assert f.name == 'f'

def test_undefined_function_assumptions():
    f = Function('f', real=True)
    assert f(x).is_real == True

def test_undefined_function_symbol_name():
    s = Symbol('f', real=True)
    f = Function(s)
    assert f(x).is_real == True

def test_undefined_function_eq():
    f = Function('f')
    g = Function('g')
    f2 = Function('f')
    assert f == f2
    assert f != g

def test_undefined_function_hash():
    f = Function('f')
    f2 = Function('f')
    assert hash(f) == hash(f2)

def test_undefined_function_invalid_name():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        Function(123)

def test_undefined_function_ne():
    f = Function('f')
    g = Function('g')
    assert f != g


# ===== Tests for WildFunction =====

def test_wild_function_basic():
    F = WildFunction('F')
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).match(F) == {F: f(x)}

def test_wild_function_nargs():
    F = WildFunction('F')
    assert F.nargs == S.Naturals0

def test_wild_function_nargs_specific():
    F = WildFunction('F', nargs=2)
    assert F.nargs == FiniteSet(2)
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).match(F) is None
    assert f(x, y).match(F) == {F: f(x, y)}

def test_wild_function_nargs_range():
    F = WildFunction('F', nargs=(1, 2))
    assert F.nargs == FiniteSet(1, 2)
    f = Function('f')
    assert f(x).match(F) == {F: f(x)}
    assert f(x, y).match(F) == {F: f(x, y)}
    assert f(x, y, z).match(F) is None

def test_wild_function_no_match_non_function():
    F = WildFunction('F')
    assert x.match(F) is None

def test_wild_function_match_cos():
    F = WildFunction('F')
    assert cos(x).match(F) == {F: cos(x)}


# ===== Tests for Derivative =====

def test_derivative_basic():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x)
    assert d.expr == f(x)

def test_derivative_evaluate():
    assert Derivative(x**2, x, evaluate=True) == 2*x

def test_derivative_denesting():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(Derivative(f(x, y), y), x)
    assert d == Derivative(f(x, y), y, x)

def test_derivative_contiguous_merge():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x, x)
    assert d == Derivative(f(x), (x, 2))

def test_derivative_canonical():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x, y), y, x, evaluate=True)
    assert d == Derivative(f(x, y), x, y)

def test_derivative_wrt_applied_undef():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x)**2, f(x), evaluate=True)
    assert d == 2*f(x)

def test_derivative_chain_rule():
    f = Function('f')
    g = Function('g')
    d = f(g(x)).diff(x)
    assert d == Derivative(f(g(x)), g(x)) * Derivative(g(x), x)

def test_derivative_subs():
    f = Function('f')
    d = f(2*x + 3).diff(x)
    assert d == 2*Subs(Derivative(f(y), y), y, 2*x + 3)

def test_derivative_free_symbols():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x)
    assert x in d.free_symbols

def test_derivative_variables():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), (x, 2))
    assert d.variables == (x, x)

def test_derivative_variable_count():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), (x, 2))
    assert d.variable_count == (Tuple(x, 2),)

def test_derivative_derivative_count():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), (x, 3))
    assert d.derivative_count == 3

def test_derivative_diff_wrt():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x)
    assert d._diff_wrt == True

def test_derivative_diff_wrt_false():
    d = Derivative(cos(x), x)
    assert d._diff_wrt == False

def test_derivative_doit():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(x**2, x)
    assert d.doit() == 2*x

def test_derivative_invalid_wrt():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Derivative(x*y, x*y)

def test_derivative_zero_order():
    f = Function('f')
    assert Derivative(f(x), x, 0) == f(x)

def test_derivative_sort_variable_count():
    vsort = Derivative._sort_variable_count
    assert vsort([(x, 1), (x, 1)]) == [Tuple(x, 2)]

def test_derivative_is_commutative():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x)
    assert d.is_commutative == True

def test_derivative_kind():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(f(x), x)
    from sympy.core.kind import NumberKind
    assert d.kind == NumberKind

def test_derivative_nseries():
    f = Function('f')
    d = Derivative(sin(x), x)
    # just check it doesn't error
    result = d.doit()
    assert result == cos(x)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def make_mark(name, args=(), kwargs=None):
    if kwargs is None:
        kwargs = {}
    return Mark(name=name, args=args, kwargs=kwargs)


def make_item(markers=None, config=None):
    """Create a minimal mock Item."""
    item = MagicMock()
    item._store = Store()
    if config is None:
        config = MagicMock()
        config.option.runxfail = False
        config.getini.return_value = False
    item.config = config

    _markers = markers or []

    def iter_markers(name=None):
        if name is None:
            return _markers
        return [m for m in _markers if m.name == name]

    item.iter_markers.side_effect = iter_markers
    item.obj = MagicMock()
    item.obj.__globals__ = {}
    return item

class TestPytestRuntestMakereport:

    def _make_call_info(self, excinfo=None, when="call"):

        call.excinfo = excinfo
        call.when = when
        return call

    def _make_report(self, outcome="passed", skipped=False, when="call"):
        rep = MagicMock()
        rep.outcome = outcome
        rep.skipped = skipped
        rep.passed = outcome == "passed"
        rep.when = when
        rep.longrepr = None

        outcome_mock = MagicMock()
        outcome_mock.get_result.return_value = rep
        gen = pytest_runtest_makereport(item, call)
        next(gen)
        gen.send(outcome_mock)
        try:

        except StopIteration:
            pass
        return rep

class TestPytestConfigure:

        try:

            # nop should have Exception attribute
            assert hasattr(pytest_module.xfail, "Exception")
            # calling nop should not raise
            pytest_module.xfail("anything")
        finally:
            # Restore
            pytest_module.xfail = old_xfail

    def test_configure_cleanup_restores_xfail(self):
        config = MagicMock()
        config.option.runxfail = True
        config._cleanup = []
        import pytest as pytest_module
        old_xfail = pytest_module.xfail
        try:
            pytest_configure(config)
            assert len(config._cleanup) == 1
            # Run cleanup
            config._cleanup[0]()
            assert pytest_module.xfail is old_xfail
        finally:
            pytest_module.xfail = old_xfail
